quest.title: Eight Locales Over Mountains and Seas: Two Cities' Recommendations
quest.description: You agreed to Ioroi's request to "bring Kichiboushi out to train." This time, you're bringing him to check out the cuisines of other lands. After all, treasure and food never betrays!
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Hero's Wit x2, Mora x20000

talks.objective: Go to the Good Hunter restaurant in Mondstadt

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hi, Sara!

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: #Why, welcome, Paimon and {NICKNAME}! And who's this? Some new Baron Bunny model...?

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Kichiboushi!

choices.text: This is Kichiboushi.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yup, this is a new friend of ours from Inazuma!

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Mm, good friends!

response.speaker: Sara
response.text: Ah, I see. Well then, welcome to Good Hunter, Kichiboushi!

response.speaker: Sara
response.text: Inazuma, huh. That's incredible... I heard Cyrus mention that it was surrounded by thunderstorms, and that there's lightning everywhere, like what happens when Ms. Lisa gets angry. That seems quite terrifying, to be honest!

choices.text: It is.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So we're here at Good Hunter to treat Kichiboushi to some authentic Mondstadt cuisine! So, Sara, could we have one Sweet Madame and...

response.speaker: Sara
response.text: Um, my apologies, but we can't actually take orders right now because... Hmm, how should I explain this?

response.speaker: Sara
response.text: I suppose you can see that we're booked to capacity?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? But there's no one here...

response.speaker: Sara
response.text: Captain Kaeya put in a very expensive order for several dozen people at the Goth Grand Hotel. Our chefs are currently busy as can be...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Kaeya? That seems a little fishy...

choices.text: He probably has some ongoing plans...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, that's alright! After all...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #That's right! There's no going without good food with you around, {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Make Lavender Melon? Grilled Melon?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No, no! Seriously, just how much do you like Lavender Melons...

response.speaker: Sara
response.text: Well, you can use the open-air stove over here any time.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Thanks, Sara. Alright then, {NICKNAME}! It's time for some delectable Sweet Madame — crispy on the outside, tender on the inside! Kichiboushi's gonna love it!

choices.text: You mean you're gonna love it, right?

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: *rumble*... Sounds tasty.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You see? Kichiboushi wants to eat, too! Don't disappoint Pai— Err, don't disappoint him now!

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Yey! Disappoint!

choices.text: One Sweet Madame coming right up!
I can make some too.
It's not that bad, really...
Wait, what's this got to do with Lisa...?
This is Baron Bunny.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Baron Funny?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! That's not right. This is Kichiboushi, a new friend we met in Inazuma!

choices.text: This here is Guoba.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Guoba?

response.speaker: Sara
response.text: Guoba? Are you referring to Jueyun Guoba, that dish from Liyue...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! That's not right. This is Kichiboushi, a new friend we met in Inazuma!

talks.objective: Sit down for a fine meal with Kichiboushi and Paimon

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Never seen this before. But smells good. *rumble*

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #And there's our Delicious Sweet Madame! You could even call it {NICKNAME}'s signature dish!

choices.text: We certainly have made a lot of them along the way.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Right! No lack of supplies out in the wild, after all.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You enjoy the Delicious Sweet Madame together.\nKichiboushi had some reservations at first, but ultimately fell to the delectable temptations of the dish and proceeded to tuck in.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: ...Oooh...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Kichiboushi? What's wrong?

choices.text: Did he eat too much?

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Mm! It's delicious! Amazing!

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: There are things better than Lavender Melon! Mm!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's pretty good, eh? ...Hey, leave Paimon some!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Between Paimon and Kichiboushi, the Sweet Madame stands as much chance as a twig in a whirlwind.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: #Phew! Delicious! {NICKNAME}, amazing!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Wow! You actually remembered {NICKNAME}'s name! So, do bake-danuki get smarter as they eat more delicious food?

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Mm, what White Fur say?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: She's Paimon.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Byemon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's Paimon!

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Spymon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh! You're so annoying!

choices.text: Better get used to it, Paimon.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Try to remember peoples' names, Kichiboushi.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Kichiboushi will try. Sorry, Paimore.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's not Paimore, it's Paimon. It's okay, though. Paimon's not mad anymore.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Delicious Sweet Madame. Very good. Thank you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And then he remembers the names of dishes just fine!

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: It was good. Not Lavender Melon or Seagrass or Berries, but it was so tasty.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'm glad you enjoyed it.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Training, very fun.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Speaking of which, since we're here in Mondstadt...

choices.text: You have a point there...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's go to see Anemo Archon statue, Kichiboushi!

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Anemo Archon? Like the Electro Archon?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's exactly right! The Anemo Archon is Mondstadt's god, just like the Electro Archon is Inazuma's.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: ...Very scary.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't worry, it's just a statue, not the real archon.

choices.text: Let's go visit the Anemo Archon statue.
I'll make you something good later...
You okay over there?
Eh, I think I'm alright at this.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And speaking of Kaeya...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #"Paimon sees you already have the knightly virtue of modesty," {NICKNAME}!

talks.objective: Go to the Anemo Archon statue in front of the Cathedral

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Sweet Madame... This dish seems simple enough, but it's quite the test of a chef's skills.

talks.objective: Climb up to the statue's hands

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You see? Nothing to be afraid of!

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Mm. Anemo Archon very tall, taller than Ioroi. Very hard, too. Tall and hard.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's... just not going to cover the differences between the statue and the real guy.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The Anemo Archon is a nice person.

choices.text: The Anemo Archon's not very reliable, but he's a gentle soul.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You know, Paimon wonders if Barbara's discovered the thing with the Holy Lyre der Himmel...

choices.text: "Hehe."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And what's that supposed to mean, huh?

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Mm! Photo!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alrighty! Hold still for a second!

choices.text: Hopefully, she hasn't.
Hopefully she has.
The Anemo Archon's a gentle soul, but he's a bit of a flake sometimes...

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: See!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Come on, don't rush!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You show Kichiboushi and Paimon the picture you just took.

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: So cool. Very big hands.

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Go back, show Ioroi, Anemo Archon hands bigger than Ioroi's!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I don't think any comparison can be made here...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: "Ioroi, weak."

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Ioroi, so, so weak, mm-haha!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, hey! Stop teaching Kichiboushi bad stuff!

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: When Ioroi is serious, he can grow very, very big. Bigger than one hundred tatami.

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Ioroi very powerful. But Kichiboushi will become more powerful!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh. Why do you wanna get stronger, Kichiboushi?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's right, you're pretty strong as-is, Kichiboushi. You can create that gliding airbag. You're about half as powerful as Paimon for sure!

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Kichiboushi must become more powerful and use stronger magic.

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: With stronger magic, Kichiboushi can make Ioroi not-stone!

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: #So Kichiboushi must train, with {NICKNAME} and Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So that's how it is...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: —Eh! You remembered Paimon's name! Woohoo!

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Woohoo! Mm-haha!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Keep it up, Kichiboushi.

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Keep it up! Yey!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well then, where should we go next?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, since we've had some Mondstadt cuisine, time to pay Liyue Harbor a visit!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We haven't tried Wanmin Restaurant's food in quite a while, too!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We just ate, you know...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe! Different lands, different stomachs, don't you know?

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Eat! Let's go!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's go! Next stop — Wanmin Restaurant!

talks.objective: Go to Wanmin Restaurant in Liyue Harbor

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey here, Chef Mao! We'd like some Black-Back Perch Stew...

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Eh? Guests, right now? ...I'm very sorry, but we're not taking orders that the moment.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? What's going on...

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Earlier, a knight from Mondstadt came with a huge order — a feast for several dozen people, no less. He wanted to bring it to... Um, where was that place again?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The Goth Grand Hotel in Mondstadt?

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Why, yes, that's exactly it! How did you know?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That Kaeya...

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: I'm really sorry. It will be a moment before we can take your order. As you can see, our woks are all busy at the moment. Not that I have any idea how that guy is going to take all those dishes back... I just hope he doesn't waste them.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: This really was very sudden. In fact, we're running so low on ingredients that Xiangling's having to go out and help gather some Jueyun Chilis.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh no...

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Mmmm...

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Eh? Who's this little fellow?

choices.text: This is Kichiboushi.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: How do you do?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yup. This guy here's a bake-danuki who's on a journey to hone his skills!

response.speaker: Chef Mao
response.text: Ah, I see. I'm very sorry, then, Kichiboushi.

response.speaker: Chef Mao
response.text: Speaking of that, my girl Xiangling's got a friend named Guoba who loves eating as well. The two of you might just get along...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Well, guess it's up to you again, {NICKNAME}...

response.speaker: Geri
response.text: ...Agh! I totally forgot!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? What's going on over there?

response.speaker: Freki
response.text: Seriously? How did we not check the dates...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What happened?

response.speaker: Geri
response.text: So we booked seats at Liuli Pavilion and Xinyue Kiosk a few months back...

response.speaker: Freki
response.text: We were planning to try the pinnacles of Li Cuisine and Yue Cuisine before returning to Mondstadt.

response.speaker: Geri
response.text: But we wound up booking the seats for the same day!

response.speaker: Freki
response.text: Ugh, we should've checked those dates! What are we supposed to do now...

choices.text: Why not go to both?

response.speaker: Geri
response.text: No, that won't do.

response.speaker: Freki
response.text: No matter which one we go to first, our prior fullness will affect the experience to follow.

response.speaker: Geri
response.text: No matter which place we go to first, it won't be fair to the other — and certainly not to the cuisine they represent!

response.speaker: Freki
response.text: That would be doing a disservice to gourmet food!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Stop taking turns to talk! Paimon's getting tired out just listening to you two!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That's quite troublesome.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So to sum it up, you've booked both Liuli Pavilion and Xinyue Kiosk for today, but you can only go to one, right?

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Mm. Kichiboushi can help! Help Uncle Brown Fur and Aunt Brown Fur go, solve problem.

response.speaker: Freki
response.text: Um, is this... little critter saying something?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: He says that we can help Uncle Brown Fur and Aunt Brown Fur go to one of the places!

response.speaker: Freki
response.text: H—Hey! I—I'm a big sister, not an aunt!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon was just passing a message, okay?

response.speaker: Freki
response.text: But... Going in our place, huh? It is certainly possible, but it does feel like a waste.

response.speaker: Geri
response.text: I think it's a fine idea. It would be irresponsible of us to cancel at the last minute, anyway.

response.speaker: Freki
response.text: *sigh* But it took us so long to wait our turn...

response.speaker: Geri
response.text: Come on, Freki, we've got time. We'll just book another slot. Anyway, weren't you all about that Xinyue Kiosk seafood yesterday?

response.speaker: Geri
response.text: Let's just go to Xinyue Kiosk first. we can leave the Liuli Pavilion booking to...

response.speaker: Geri
response.text: ...These rather unusual travelers and this... little animal?

choices.text: Could we really do that?

response.speaker: Geri
response.text: Sure. I'm Geri. Just go to Liuli Pavilion and give Licai my name. The dishes should also already be booked.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hooray! Thanks, Geri!

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Hooray! Thanks, Geri!

choices.text: Then you have my thanks.
Why don't you each go to one place?

response.speaker: Geri
response.text: No, that won't do.

response.speaker: Freki
response.text: We want to experience both types of food together.

response.speaker: Geri
response.text: If not, our arguments whether Li or Yue Cuisine is better will be completely one-sided on either front!

choices.text: This is Baron Bunny.

response.speaker: Chef Mao
response.text: Baron who?

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Baron Funky?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! That's not right. This is Kichiboushi, a bake-danuki who's on a journey to hone his skills!

choices.text: This here is Guoba.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Nope, this is Kichiboushi! He's a bake-danuki who's on a journey to hone his skills! He's heard that the Guoba made here at Wanmin Restaurant is really good, so he wanted to have a try.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Jueyun Guoba!

talks.objective: Go to Liuli Pavilion and talk to Licai

dialogues.speaker: Licai
dialogues.text: Welcome to Liuli Pavilion! Do you have a reservation?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Geri booked us a table.

dialogues.speaker: Licai
dialogues.text: Mr. Geri... Please wait a moment, let me check...

dialogues.speaker: Licai
dialogues.text: Indeed, you do have a reservation for today. Well then, this way, please.

talks.objective: Have a meal at Liuli Pavilion with Kichiboushi and Paimon

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Geri did say he'd pre-booked the dishes...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But this really is a lot! Were Geri and Freki really going to eat all this by themselves?

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Ooh... Smells nice.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You have a sumptuous feast at Liuli Pavilion with Paimon and Kichiboushi...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Phew, that was delicious! How did you find it, Kichiboushi?

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Mm! Very tasty!

choices.text: I could tell just from watching you eat.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Mm-haha! Delicious. Very delicious.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Humans are very powerful! They can make such tasty food, better than bake-danuki food!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Come to think of it, what is bake-danuki food made from?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It tastes as good as it looks, and it does look good... But there's a kind of... emptiness to it?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'm quite curious myself.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Bake-danuki is made from leaves, Kapow!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Leaves Kapow... You mean vegetables?

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Leaves Kapow is Leaves Kapow. Leaves, Kapow. Very tasty.

choices.text: This all seems a little strange...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon can't stop thinking about it, though.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's also curious... What's Kaeya doing with all that food from Good Hunter and Wanmin Restaurant?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What's that guy's scheme this time...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Maybe it's going to go something like this:

choices.text: "Ding dong, ding dong! Special delivery for the Fatui!"

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "Delivery? What delivery?"

response.speaker: Player
response.text: "A full course meal from Mondstadt and Liyue!"

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "Wow! It's a feast! Thanks!"

response.speaker: Player
response.text: "Thanks for your patronage! That'll be 5 million Mora!"

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "Huh? Wh—What is this? Do our activities cost that much!? W—Well, I guess we're just going to have to leave Mondstadt then!"

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...There's no way something as silly as that could happen, right?

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Mm-haha, just like bake-danuki.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It is quite like them, true...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Also, is it just Paimon, or is the food better than last time? Why's that?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: The last time we were here, we were on official business.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, that's true. Consultant this, Rite of Parting that... The food wasn't half as good by the time we were done talking.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Speaking of that... You know, Kichiboushi, we actually ate here, together with a Fatui Harbinger and Rex Lapis himself!

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Kichiboushi once heard Ioroi talk about fat twigs.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Many fat twigs in the forest. Very hard, very uncomfortable to sit on.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Kichiboushi, we meant the "Fatui"!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You know, I doubt the bake-danuki know anything about the Fatui.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Th—That's true...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Since we're here in Liyue, let's find a place where we can take a commemorative photo for Kichiboushi!

choices.text: Let's find a spot where we can see the whole place...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yup! There's this winding mountain path on the northern entrance to Liyue Harbor, isn't there?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That should fit the bill!

choices.text: Is there a suitable location for that?
"Hey there! Here's a gift from the Knights of Favonius!"

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "A gift? Hehe! So, you're finally acknowledging our power, then?"

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "Well, it's too late to suck up to us now! *cough* Still, what's in it?"

response.speaker: Player
response.text: "A cold platter feast from Mondstadt and Liyue!"

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "Hooray! It's a cold platter feast. Time to eat, comrades!"

response.speaker: Player
response.text: "Heyah! Freeze!"

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "Ah! It's an ambush! The Cavalry Captain is hidden inside the feast platters! Argh!"

choices.text: Might be best not to investigate bake-danuki magic too deeply...
I could tell just from watching Paimon eat.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Is that supposed to be a compliment?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Alright, Kichiboushi! Face {NICKNAME} and hold still!

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Yey! Photo memory!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Yup, that looks great. You've really got a knack for this, huh, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: This place very pretty. Very different from forest.

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: But all the boats down there, not sinking?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't worry, they won't.

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Amazing!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, Kichiboushi, was today's training fun?

choices.text: It's training, you know...

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Ioroi said playing is also training. Not to leave tanuki path.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: If play forgotten, will leave tanuki path.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Leaving the tanuki path... What's gonna happen if you do that?

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Tanuki who leave the path... explode.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What!?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Huh?

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Eight tatami explode, leaf will disappear. Fur will turn into Seagrass and belly-drum turn into big teapot. Then tanuki become skinny like weasels, no more magic.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's pretty sure that Ioroi's fibbing.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Training is very fun! Very happy, mm!

choices.text: As long as you're having fun.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Keep going! Where to?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You know what, let's stop for today!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You should go rest as well, Kichiboushi.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: #Don't want rest, Kichiboushi still wants training with {NICKNAME} and Paimon.

choices.text: Rest is also a form of training.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Mm...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't worry! We'll think about where we should go next, alright?
